name: Megurine Luka no Jikenbo
source:
Hatsune Miku has risen to become a top idol charts.
Luka Megurine is developing his talent as a detective.
"I only play a detective in a TV series"
His thoughts and feelings intersect.
A short novel about a diva's love life.
"I want you to be everyone's diva forever."

a translate from [url=https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/winnt/amuse/se504083.html]vector.co[/url]]
translation:
初音未来已经登上顶级偶像排行榜的榜首。
巡音流歌则正在磨练自己的侦探才能。

“我只是在电视剧里演侦探。”

她们的想法与情感彼此交错。
这是一部讲述歌姬爱情生活的短篇小说。

“我想让你永远成为大家的歌姬。”

[改译自[url=https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/winnt/amuse/se504083.html]Vector[/url]]
